scenario.title: Model facts, execution levels and capacity
situations: The user wants cheaper or stronger workers.
A new model appears or a level cannot launch.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Live capacity and native-provider observations were not exercised; freshness and external-account behavior need runtime evidence.

lessons.title: Separate facts from staffing policy
lessons.when: Looking up a model or proposing a level change
lessons.need: Catalog research holds sourced model/pricing facts and effective dates; execution levels select launches. Unknown research does not mean unlaunchable. Changing the catalog does not silently change level preferences.
lessons.surface: Yoke Help -> Models skill; docs sidebar -> CLI/config -> model reference and execution levels.

lessons.title: Read effective levels and real capacity
lessons.when: Before choosing a worker level or explaining why staffing is blocked
lessons.need: Project override wins over universe/default levels. Read source and live option/machine/quota blockers; use launch preview instead of predicting capacity. An unreadable meter is unknown, not exhausted.
lessons.surface: Settings Levels documented view -> level-summary/capacity; Steer model-selection -> preview.
recipes: yoke session-control launch preview --project P --level SENIOR

lessons.title: Inspect native availability and support limits
lessons.when: A requested model/effort/context is missing or refused
lessons.need: Observed surface availability and the receiving machine matter. Unknown/stale/unsupported probes are different states. Preserve exact refusal; a provider rejection does not authorize an alternate hidden launch path.
lessons.surface: CLI/config observed-model section -> list-models and probe help; Steer exact-model recipe.
